# Secrets Template File
# DO NOT COMMIT THIS FILE TO GIT!
# Use this template to create secrets manually

# How to use:
# 1. Copy this file to a secure location outside your git repo
# 2. Fill in the values
# 3. Create secrets using: kubectl create secret generic lampiao-secrets --from-literal=... -n lampiao-prod
# 4. OR use External Secrets operator to automate

# ============================================
# Database
# ============================================
# Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32
DB_PASSWORD=your_strong_password_here_20_chars_min

# ============================================
# JWT / Authentication
# ============================================
# Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32
JWT_SECRET=your_jwt_secret_here_change_frequently

# ============================================
# Google OAuth
# ============================================
# Get from: https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials
GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID=your_google_client_id.apps.googleusercontent.com
GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET=your_google_client_secret_here

# ============================================
# AWS (for S3, if using)
# ============================================
AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE
AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=wJalrXUtnFEMI/K7MDENG/bPxRfiCYEXAMPLEKEY

# ============================================
# SendGrid (for email, if using)
# ============================================
SENDGRID_API_KEY=SG.your_sendgrid_api_key_here

# ============================================
# Stripe (for payments, if using)
# ============================================
STRIPE_API_KEY=sk_live_your_stripe_key_here
STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET=whsec_your_webhook_secret_here

# ============================================
# Create secrets with kubectl:
# ============================================
# kubectl create secret generic lampiao-secrets \
#   --from-literal=db.password='...' \
#   --from-literal=jwt.secret='...' \
#   --from-literal=google.client.id='...' \
#   --from-literal=google.client.secret='...' \
#   -n lampiao-prod

# Or create from file:
# kubectl create secret generic lampiao-secrets \
#   --from-file=db.password \
#   -n lampiao-prod
